candidate.answerReason: The mean describes average performance, while variance describes variability around that average. These are the two features named in C.

methods.label: Interpret the two statistics
methods.explanation: The mean reflects the overall level, while the variance reflects the degree of variability (consistency) in the data. Both are needed for a comprehensive comparison.
methods.levelReason: Uses the Grade 8 meanings of mean and variance without requiring calculations.
